run_paintball_capture_the_flag: run the paintball capture the flag human player with WASD movement and space to fire
run_paintball_king_of_the_hill: run the paintball king of the hill human player with WASD movement and space to fire
run_paintball_verbose: run the paintball human player in verbose mode to print debug information
run_paintball_print_events: run the paintball human player with events printing enabled
run_paintball_custom_settings: run the paintball human player with custom JSON settings for the environment
